summary_paraphrase: When a young turtle's grandmother is hurt and his parents leave to help her, his bunny friend invites him to stay in her tree; they play, eat and sleep side by side, and when the family returns Granny gives him her flute and everyone dances.

beats.function: a day and a night in the friend's world, ending in sleep
family returns; Tendai asks after Granny
music and dancing under the tree

characters.name: Tendai Turtle
characters.desire: to be with his family; to be safe while they are away
characters.fear: (INFERRED) worry about Granny and being left
characters.change: from worried to the one who makes the music

characters.name: Bunny Busi
characters.relation_to_protagonist: best friend and host; she sets the mood rather than mirroring his (cheerful while he is worried on page 3)
characters.humor_source: standing on his shell, pushing a turtle on a swing

humor_notes: Picture-only and gentle: a turtle on a swing, a bunny standing on a shell to reach berries, both lying belly-up when full.

repetition.description: 'They <verb> all day' / 'They <verb> all night' pair two short sentences across the stay
repetition.why: the parallel compresses a day and a night into a pattern a pre-reader can hear, and makes the time apart feel short and safe

repetition.description: butterflies recur on the play, return and gift spreads
repetition.why: a picture motif marks happy moments without words

notes: Granny's injury is explained only in a thought bubble (page 2).
Page 6 is wordless and carries the funniest moments.
The flute and the bandage are planted in the picture on page 8 before the text names them.
In the download, after the last text spread come a decorative butterfly-and-squirrel pattern and a small square vignette repeating the night scene; neither is part of the story pages analysed here.

strengths: a separation story told as an adventure in a friend's home
the stay compressed into a calm day-night parallel
celebration that joins both worlds at the end
clues planted in pictures before the text
weaknesses: Tendai's feelings during the stay are not shown in words; the separation worry is only implied
the flute arrives without earlier set-up in the text

child_appeal_heuristic.label: Research heuristic — not validated
child_appeal_heuristic.rationale: Scores are the analyst's reading of the pages, not observations of children.

age_suitability.notes: A grandparent's injury and a night away from parents, both shown gently and resolved. Peak 5/5 on the research scale (engine 0-3 scale: 3) on the final dancing page; the sleep page sits mid-book at 1/5 (engine 1). Not bedtime-framed: the story does not open or close at bed.

metrics.lexicon_note: direct_address and sound_words are lexicon counts: a floor, not a measure. direct_address counts second-person words anywhere, dialogue included — it is not narrator-to-reader address

repetition.end_rhyme_note: heuristic: consecutive lines sharing a final two letters
